title: Proliferatins suppress lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammation via inhibition of the NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways.
authors: Kuang, Qi-Xuan; Li, Qing-Zhou; Lei, Li-Rong; Wang, Yu-Mei; Huang, Li-Jun; Dai, Yi-Fei; Peng, Wan; Zhang, Ming-Zhi; Wang, Dong; Gu, Yu-Cheng; Deng, Yun; Guo, Da-le
one_liner_zh: 该文研究真菌聚酮类化合物的抗炎作用机制，涉及NF-kappaB/MAPK信号通路及TLR4-MD-2分子对接，但核心是炎症信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅分子对接为弱相关方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Three previously undescribed polyketides [proliferatin A-C (1-3)] with anti-inflammatory activity were isolated from Fusarium proliferatum. 1-3 attenuated the production of inflammatory signal messengers including nitric oxide (NO), reactive oxygen species, proinflammatory cytokines interleukin-6 (IL-6), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), and interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), as well as the related proteins nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) and cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced RAW264.7 macrophages. Transcriptome analyses based on RNA-seq indicated the potential anti-inflammatory mechanism of 1-3 involved in the nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB) and mitogen activated protein kinases (MAPKs) signaling pathways. Experimental evaluation of the protein levels revealed that 1-3 can inhibit the phosphorylation of IkappaB kinase (IKK), the degradation of NF-kappaB Inhibitor-alpha (IkappaBalpha), the phosphorylation of nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) and can reduce NF-kappaB transportation to the nucleus. Interestingly, 1-3 decreased the phosphorylation of MAPKs including p-p38, p-ERK, and p-JNK. Molecular docking models suggest that binding of 1-3 to TLR4-MD-2 complex may lead to inhibition of NF-kappaB and MAPK signaling pathways, which was confirmed in vitro by surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays. 1-3 can thus constitute potential therapeutic candidates for the treatment of inflammation-associated diseases.
abstract_zh: 从增殖镰刀菌（Fusarium proliferatum）中分离出三种具有抗炎活性的未描述聚酮类化合物[增殖素A-C (1-3)]。1-3减弱了炎症信号信使的产生，包括一氧化氮（NO）、活性氧、促炎细胞因子白细胞介素-6（IL-6）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-alpha）和白细胞介素-1β（IL-1beta），以及相关蛋白一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）和环氧合酶-2（COX-2）在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中。基于RNA-seq的转录组分析表明，1-3的潜在抗炎机制涉及核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）和丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPKs）信号通路。蛋白质水平的实验评估显示，1-3能抑制IkappaB激酶（IKK）的磷酸化、NF-kappaB抑制剂-α（IkappaBalpha）的降解、核因子-kappaB（NF-kappaB）的磷酸化，并减少NF-kappaB向细胞核的转运。有趣的是，1-3降低了MAPKs的磷酸化，包括p-p38、p-ERK和p-JNK。分子对接模型表明，1-3与TLR4-MD-2复合物的结合可能导致NF-kappaB和MAPK信号通路的抑制，这通过表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验在体外得到证实。因此，1-3可作为治疗炎症相关疾病的潜在候选药物。
